claude_code.supported_min_source: the .claude-plugin/marketplace.json schema this catalog ships has been stable since 2.0.0; the previous floor was never validated
claude_code.verification_method: Live-CLI revalidation on 2026-10-21 -- this run's runner has the `claude` CLI installed and `claude --version` reports `2.1.306 (Claude Code)`, matching the target exactly. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance from 2.1.300 to **2.1.306** together (no divergence), covering six releases (2.1.301-2.1.306). Reviewed every changelog entry across that range for catalog surface -- none required a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (or generated `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` / `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`) schema change: 2.1.301-2.1.302 (`.catch` on a mod hook now runs only on throw or timeout, `$.env.set` resolves `{}`/`{ deny }`, at most 12 prompt/agent hooks of one event run concurrently, fork subagents default on, `-p`/SDK start in `default` permission mode on third-party/telemetry-off, MCP servers negotiating protocol 2026-07-28 without `resultType`/`ttlMs`/`cacheScope` no longer show no tools) is all mod-dev/CLI surface -- this catalog ships no `hooks.json`/`plugin.json`/`.mcp.json` of its own. 2.1.303 is bug fixes and reliability improvements only, with no itemized changelog entries. 2.1.304 (`/auto-mode-setup`, `decider: "person"` and `e.isReadOnly` on a mod's `tool.check` event, `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, tool search on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, a cap of 1,024 hooks/16,384 matcher characters per skill source) is mod-dev/gateway surface with nothing to change here. 2.1.305 (`sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces`, `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS`, a narrower `allowedMcpServers` filter for `managed-mcp.json`, an `/artifacts` delete-confirmation UX change) touches no marketplace manifest. 2.1.306 fixed `claude -p` in cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" without the session's environment variables, and an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long" in sessions with many MCP tools -- host-side reliability fixes this catalog benefits from passively. Re-ran `claude plugin validate --strict .` against this catalog's own marketplace manifest on the live 2.1.306 CLI: clean, no warnings. `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests, agent-drift, feature-equivalence, platform-targets, GitHub-Actions-SHA-pinning, `scripts/validate-marketplaces.py`) passes clean: 3 plugins in sync. `bash scripts/check-platform-targets.sh . --assert-current` passes once `validated_against`/`latest_known` both land on 2.1.306 (it failed with "Stale platform target claude_code" when only `latest_known` had been advanced, confirming the check actually fires). Cross-repo note: the gating-hooks finding escalated in this PR's Future opportunities since the 2.1.299 cycle ("`tamirs-superpowers`' mod has 4 gating hooks without a `.catch`") is now RESOLVED upstream -- `tamirs-superpowers` 5.0.0/5.0.1 added explicit `.catch(($, e, next) => next(e))` handlers to all four (`agent.spawn`, `prompt.submit`, `tool.call`, `session.compact`), confirmed live by that repo's own `claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `make test-mods` (56/56 passing) against the 2.1.306 CLI. No action needed here; the install guide, `docs/agent-guidelines/security.md`, and `docs/agent-guidelines/testing.md` are updated below to stop carrying the stale escalation. Only Claude Code entries in this shared platform-target file were touched; Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode values are untouched. Prior verification (2026-10-14): Live-CLI revalidation on 2026-10-14 — this run's runner has the `claude` CLI installed and `claude --version` reports `2.1.300 (Claude Code)`, matching the target exactly. `validated_against` and `latest_known` both advance from 2.1.293 to **2.1.300** together (no divergence), covering seven releases (2.1.294–2.1.300; 2.1.297/2.1.298 do not exist as public releases). Reviewed every changelog entry across that range for catalog surface — none required a `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (or generated `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` / `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json`) schema change. The one catalog-adjacent theme in this range is a **hook-failure semantics change spanning three releases**, reviewed in depth against the sibling plugin repos since this manifest-only catalog ships no `hooks.json`/`plugin.json` of its own: 2.1.295 added `onFailure: "block"` for command/HTTP hooks (a hook that can't start, times out, or exits unexpectedly now blocks the action under that setting); 2.1.299 changed the *unset* default itself — an action a plugin hook can block is now refused, not let through, when the hook can't be handed the call or can't hand back an answer; and 2.1.294 separately fixed `prompt`/`agent` hooks written as natural-language instructions (e.g. "Block commands that...") allowing what they should have blocked. Re-ran `claude plugin validate --strict --json` against all three listed plugin repos on the live 2.1.300 CLI as a deeper audit: `tamirs-superpowers`' mod (`mod/register.tsx`) still registers its 4 gating hooks (`agent.spawn`, `prompt.submit`, `tool.call`, `session.compact`) with no `.catch` — previously a soft finding ('fails open or closed depending on the mod runtime's own default'), now resolved by 2.1.299 to fail **closed** (the call is refused), which is a safer default but means an unhandled exception in any of those four hooks now blocks the action it would have let through before — escalated under Future opportunities for that repo's own nightly. Also newly observed this run: `claude plugin validate --strict --json` on 2.1.300 reports a 'CLAUDE.md at the plugin root is not loaded as project context' warning for all three listed plugin repos (`tamirs-superpowers`, `jose-claudinho`, `headhunter` each ship a root `CLAUDE.md` beside `plugin.json`), which was not present in the 2026-10-07 audit on 2.1.293 and is not tied to a specific numbered changelog entry — flagged for those repos, not actionable here. `headhunter` still carries its 3 pre-existing unknown-field warnings (`engines`/`peerDependencies`/`requiredEnvVars`); `jose-claudinho` is otherwise clean. Re-ran `claude plugin test .` against `tamirs-superpowers`' mod suite live on 2.1.300: 21/21 pass, unchanged from the 2.1.293 run. Reviewed and found no further catalog surface: 2.1.294's hook-judging fix (no `hooks.json` here); 2.1.295's Program Status Protocol, `$.ui.notify` and mod-`Button` children (mod-dev/terminal-UI only), MCP tool-description cut raised to 16,384 chars and claude.ai-connector MCP protocol 2026-07-28 default (no `.mcp.json` here), and the README-install-line advice in `claude plugin validate` (this catalog's own README already has one, confirmed clean); 2.1.296's `code` gateway-policy key, `autoCompactWindow` for subagents, default MCP description/instruction limit 2,048→4,096, and Sonnet 5.5 cache-read pricing (no gateway, subagents, `.mcp.json`, or billing surface here); 2.1.299's `$.prompt.media`/`$.session.identity()` for managed-settings mods, idle compaction, `UserPromptSubmit` now running before skill/command expansion, and MCP allow rules matching only the exact named server (no `.mcp.json` or permission-rule examples in this catalog's docs — checked directly); and 2.1.300's `virtualText` mod decorations, `$.ui.view({agentId})`, the `prompt.change` mod hook, and `updatedInput` from PreToolUse/PermissionRequest hooks now being validated (all mod-dev/hooks surface relevant to `tamirs-superpowers`' own mod and hooks, not to this manifest-only catalog — noted for that repo's own review) and the removal of the no-op `--sandbox`/`--no-sandbox` flags from `claude remote-control` (this catalog's own scripts never invoke `claude remote-control`). `make validate` (regenerate + validate manifests, `make agent:check`, 3 plugins in sync, no drift), `make validate-skills` (`claude plugin validate --strict --json .agents/skills`), `make assert-contract`, `scripts/check-platform-targets.sh --assert-current`, and `claude plugin validate --strict .` on the marketplace manifest all pass clean against the live 2.1.300 CLI. Only Claude Code entries in this shared platform-target file were touched; Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode values are untouched. Prior verification (2026-10-07): 2.1.293 was confirmed live and reviewed for the 2.1.287 → 2.1.293 delta — see the install guide's per-version sections for full history.

cursor.supported_min_source: Cursor documents no minimum version for plugins; the floor is the version actually validated rather than guessed. The previous 0.45.0 floor predates Cursor's plugin system entirely
cursor.verification_method: latest desktop build from official Cursor download links (3.18.9, 2026-08-30 stable) cross-checked against cursor.com/changelog (feature 3.11; date-only entries through 2026-09-02 Self-Hosted Machines / Team Pools / partner sandboxes / computer use); team-marketplace import is a Dashboard flow

codex.supported_min_source: earliest release this catalog has claimed .agents/plugins/marketplace.json support for
codex.verification_method: documentary revalidation by this repo's standing Codex method (official release notes plus catalog compatibility review; the Codex CLI is not installed on the review machine). Reviewed every openai/codex release from 0.148.0 through 0.153.4 for plugin/marketplace changes: #41208 (0.151.0) reports invalid project marketplaces without hiding valid plugins, #41953 (0.153.0) enforces a marketplace source policy for OpenAI-curated plugins only, and #42149/#42150 (0.153.0) upgrade Git marketplaces from merged configuration and add remote-marketplace support to the plugin CLI. None alter the portable Agent Plugin catalog shape, so .agents/plugins/marketplace.json remains discoverable unchanged; 0.153.0 widens how it can be consumed rather than narrowing it.

opencode.supported_min_source: oldest version on which `skills.paths` discovery of a catalog plugin's skills was verified with `opencode debug skill`
opencode.verification_method: `opencode --version` on the maintainer machine (reported 1.18.29); latest from registry.npmjs.org/opencode-ai. OpenCode has no marketplace, so the catalog itself cannot be installed — skill discovery is verified directly with `opencode debug skill`, pointing `skills.paths` at this repo's `.agents/skills` and confirming `run-plugins-catalog` resolves to its `SKILL.md`

capability_gaps.marketplace: OpenCode has no plugin marketplace and no plugin manifest, so this catalog cannot be added as an install source. Each plugin repo is installed directly — clone it and point `skills.paths` at its `skills/` directory, or symlink it into the OpenCode skills directory. Every plugin in this catalog ships its own `opencode.json` and its own OpenCode install guide.
capability_gaps.catalog_discovery: There is no OpenCode equivalent of listing plugins from a remote catalog. The plugin table in this repo's README is the discovery surface; installation is then per-repo.
